local VariablesLua = mw.ext.VariablesLua

local p = {}

function p.getVar(key)
	local val = VariablesLua.var(key)
	if val == '' then
		return nil
	end
	return val
end

function p.setVar(key, val)
	VariablesLua.vardefine(key, val)
	return val
end

function p.getObject(key)
	local val = p.getVar(key)
	if not val then
		return nil
	end
	return mw.text.jsonDecode(val) -- feels kinda hacky
end

function p.setObject(key, val)
	local val_to_store = mw.text.jsonEncode(val)
	p.setVar(key, val_to_store)
	return val
end

return p
